save.description: First avoids damage; second avoids capture

effect: Transform for up to two rounds; height 10-30 ft. Small or smaller creatures caught take damage each round. Flying captives can save again to escape. No normal attacks while transformed.

description.value: Airborne creatures take a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against an air elemental.

contextNotes.text: Airborne enemies take -1 on attack and damage rolls against this elemental.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, an air elemental can launch a gust of wind that engulfs their enemy within 30 feet for 4d4 points of wind damage and is inflicted with the Squalled status for 1d4 rounds. The target of this ability must make a Fortitude save (DC 13) to reduce the damage by half and negate the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

effect: On a failed save, Squalled for [[1d4]] rounds.
